metadata.description: PRIMA Scholar for Claude Code: academic search across ten databases, a local research library, and citation-aware writing.

plugins.name: prima-scholar
plugins.description: Research workspace with academic search (PubMed, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, CrossRef, OpenAlex, Europe PMC, DBLP, ERIC, bioRxiv/medRxiv, CORE), a local SQLite document library with full-text search, citation-aware writing, and a literature watch. Two bundled MCP servers; build them after installing.
